niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces that feel bright, airy, polished, and clearly structured, with strong hierarchy, concise copy, and enough visible content to feel complete. They like screens that are informative and functional, but not cluttered or overly dense. They tend to favor clean list-based layouts, clear section separation, visible actions, and contextual detail when it helps the screen feel grounded and trustworthy.

criteria.description: Light, airy, polished screens with a clean overall feel rather than dark, heavy, or oppressive styling.
Interfaces with clearly separated sections, strong grouping, and an obvious hierarchy between major areas.
Screens that feel populated and complete, with enough visible information to avoid emptiness or placeholder-like gaps.
Short, direct, and easy-to-scan copy that avoids verbose explanations or overly dense text blocks.
Clear emphasis on the main title, primary content, and key actions, with competing elements minimized.
Plain, functional list rows and controls that feel clean and readable rather than heavily boxed or overdesigned.
Primary actions, toggles, chevrons, and per-item controls should be obvious and easy to understand at a glance.
Layouts should feel fully built, intentional, and polished, not sparse, unfinished, or placeholder-like.
The user likes screens that retain useful surrounding context and supporting details instead of feeling isolated or abstract.
